name: Heatmor
description: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

name: Kangaskhan
description: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is three years old.

name: Minior
description: This is its form when its shell has fallen off. The color of its core depends on the materials that made up the food it ate.

name: Arrokuda
description: After it's eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That's when Cramorant swallows it up.

name: Sandshrew
description: It lives in areas of limited rainfall. When danger approaches, it curls up into a ball to protect its soft stomach.

name: Mr. Mime
description: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

name: Ho-Oh
description: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

name: Flareon
description: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

name: Snorunt
description: In some snowy lands, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a ______ lives there.

name: Alolan Marowak
description: The bones it possesses were once its mother's. Its mother's regrets have become like a vengeful spirit protecting this Pokémon.

name: Chespin
description: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Wiglett
description: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Ekans
description: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and ______ faints.

name: Joltik
description: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Uxie
description: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

name: Quilava
description: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

name: Combee
description: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

name: Durant
description: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves against Heatmor.

name: Dark Vaporeon
description: A Pokémon capable of controlling water, so it is capable of creating giant whirlpools.

name: Miraidon
description: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

name: Feebas
description: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms in schools and lives at the bottom of rivers.

name: Staryu
description: Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.

name: Gligar
description: It spends its days hanging from cliffs, swooping down on any prey it spots from its high vantage point.

name: Victreebel
description: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Pikipek
description: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

name: Wooper
description: It lives in cold water, half burying itself in mud at the bottom to sleep.

name: Swinub
description: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

name: Dreepy
description: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, ______ wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Tentacruel
description: Normally, it has 80 poisonous tentacles. The longer one has been alive, the fewer tentacles it will have.

name: Wigglytuff
description: Thanks to its bouncy body and fine fur, this Pokémon is sought after. Holding one in your arms while you sleep feels great.

name: Tentacool
description: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

name: Manaphy
description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Minccino
description: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

name: Snom
description: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

name: Tangrowth
description: Even if one of its arms is eaten, it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

name: Haxorus
description: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

name: Ninjask
description: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

name: Bisharp
description: Violent conflicts erupt between ______ and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

name: Rapidash
description: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

name: Joltik
description: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Hoppip
description: It drifts on winds. It is said that when ______ gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

name: Skrelp
description: It vanishes into seaweed and remains perfectly still to avoid attacks from large Pokémon. Rotten seaweed is its main food source.

name: Ferroseed
description: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

name: Hippopotas
description: Though large and languid, ______ is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

name: Hitmontop
description: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by ten.

name: Liepard
description: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

name: Gyarados
description: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Hawlucha
description: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

name: Typhlosion
description: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

name: Tsareena
description: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon's legs leaves a wound in the opponent's body and soul that will never heal.

name: Pikipek
description: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for attacks it fires off from its mouth.

name: Chansey
description: The egg ______ carries is not only delicious but also packed with nutrition. It's used as a high-class cooking ingredient.

name: Medicham
description: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

name: Blastoise
description: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

name: Hoopa
description: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

name: Nidorina
description: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than NIDORINO's.

name: Misdreavus
description: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.

name: Snorlax
description: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

name: Shellos East Sea
description: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

name: Ribombee
description: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs' effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.

name: Empoleon
description: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

name: Oranguru
description: People used to mistake ______ for a human when they saw it issue command after command to the other Pokémon of the forest.

name: Kingdra
description: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

name: Remoraid
description: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

name: Gabite
description: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

name: Reuniclus
description: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.

name: Lanturn
description: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

name: Hitmonchan
description: While seeming to do nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

name: Tropius
description: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

name: Kadabra
description: Using its psychic power, ______ levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

name: Polteageist
description: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

name: Raichu
description: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Tornadus
description: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: Elgyem
description: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

name: Beedrill
description: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

name: Rayquaza
description: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: Poliwrath
description: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

name: Kakuna
description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

name: Dipplin
description: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

name: Smoliv
description: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

name: Elgyem
description: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

name: Zarude
description: Once the vines on ______'s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Misdreavus
description: What makes it happy is imitating the voices of weeping people and scaring everyone. It doesn't deal well with folks who aren't easily frightened.

name: Gible
description: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Butterfree
description: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: Victini
description: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Graveler
description: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

name: Milotic
description: When people bicker, it is said to arise from the depths of lakes to becalm violent hearts.

name: Deoxys
description: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

name: Snorlax
description: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.

name: Pinsir
description: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing its victim around and toss it hard.

name: Stunfisk
description: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

name: Empoleon
description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

name: Rotom
description: With a body made of plasma, it can inhabit all sorts of machines. It loves to surprise others.

name: Phione
description: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

name: Excadrill
description: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

name: Hattrem
description: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: Clawitzer
description: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

name: Metang
description: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

name: Palpitoad
description: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.

name: Wigglytuff
description: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won't want to be separated.

name: Pikachu
description: A plan was recently announced to gather many ______ and make an electric power plant.

name: Gible
description: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

name: Wimpod
description: It will pick up anything it finds on the ground. Sometimes it finds coins, so Murkrow and Meowth will go after it.

name: Karrablast
description: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

name: Tentacruel
description: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

name: Smoochum
description: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.

name: Geodude
description: ______ that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

name: Quagsire
description: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

name: Salazzle
description: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

name: Togekiss
description: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.

name: Spinda
description: No two SPINDA have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

name: Rotom
description: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

name: Lapras
description: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

name: Trapinch
description: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

name: Skarmory
description: Its feathers, which fall off as it grows, are thin and sharp. In times long past, warriors used them as swords.

name: Scraggy
description: Proud of its sturdy skull, it suddenly headbutts everything, but its weight makes it unstable, too.

name: Foongus
description: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

name: Furret
description: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

name: Horsea
description: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

name: Zweilous
description: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

name: Kakuna
description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

name: Heracross
description: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

name: Silicobra
description: ______'s neck pouch, which can inflate and deflate like a balloon, gets more elastic each time ______ sheds its skin.

name: Scyther
description: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

name: Orbeetle
description: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

name: Bounsweet
description: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, ______ was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

name: Pupitar
description: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

name: Morpeko
description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

name: Talonflame
description: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

name: Cleffa
description: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

name: Toxapex
description: To attack, this Pokémon sends toxic spikes flying at its enemies. Ones that come close get mown down by the claws on its feet.

name: Gloom
description: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool; it is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

name: Chansey
description: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Staryu
description: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

name: Galarian Slowbro
description: If this Pokémon squeezes the tongue of the Shellder biting it, the Shellder will launch a toxic liquid from the tip of its shell.

name: Marill
description: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

name: Avalugg
description: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

name: Galarian Slowpoke
description: Because ______ eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.

name: Duskull
description: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

name: Nidoran♂
description: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

name: Scyther
description: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

name: Baltoy
description: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

name: Charjabug
description: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, ______ strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Relicanth
description: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

name: Dialga
description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Vaporeon
description: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can't be seen when it melts away into water.

name: Mareep
description: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

name: Nidoqueen
description: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.

name: Palkia
description: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with PALKIA's every breath.

name: Simisear
description: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

name: Sentret
description: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

name: Heatran
description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

name: Galvantula
description: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

name: Spearow
description: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

name: Larvesta
description: This Pokémon was called the Larva That Stole the Sun. The fire ______ spouts from its horns can cut right through a sheet of iron.

name: Patrat
description: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Snubbull
description: It has an active, playful nature. Many people like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

name: Goodra
description: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

name: Minccino
description: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

name: Bisharp
description: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

name: Vigoroth
description: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

name: Shuckle
description: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

name: Metapod
description: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

name: Shelmet
description: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast, however, because they can still get into the shell.

name: Golduck
description: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

name: Dustox
description: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.

name: Volbeat
description: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

name: Wailord
description: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

name: Wo-Chien
description: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

name: Palpitoad
description: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

name: Goomy
description: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.

name: Dewpider
description: ______ normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

name: Pachirisu
description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Onix
description: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

name: Zorua
description: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Bulbasaur
description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

name: Illumise
description: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. There are scholars who research the meaning of these signs.

name: Klinklang
description: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
description: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

name: Magikarp
description: It is said to be the world's weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.

name: Hitmonchan
description: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Staraptor
description: When Staravia evolve into ______, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Carracosta
description: It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its developed front appendages and chew it up, shell or bones and all.

name: Groudon
description: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.

name: Tandemaus
description: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

name: Lugia
description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Morelull
description: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

name: Stunky
description: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

name: Honedge
description: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

name: Togedemaru
description: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Caterpie
description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Frost Rotom
description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Garganacl
description: ______ will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

name: Volcanion
description: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Drifblim
description: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

name: Weezing
description: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a ______.

name: Sableye
description: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

name: Team Rocket's Honchkrow
description: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than 100 of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

name: Staraptor
description: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

name: Tinkatink
description: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

name: Galarian Darumaka
description: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

name: Braviary
description: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

name: Raichu
description: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.

name: Scyther
description: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja's.

name: Axew
description: Its large tusks have a tendency to break, but each time they grow back, they grow in harder and sturdier.

name: Scorbunny
description: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

name: Magmar
description: These Pokémon's bodies are constantly burning. ______ are feared as one of the causes behind fires.

name: Shellos
description: For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.

name: Ledyba
description: They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.

name: Altaria
description: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

name: Nacli
description: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

name: Lombre
description: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

name: Araquanid
description: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

name: Oddish
description: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Ferroseed
description: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help ______'s spikes grow big and strong.

name: Lombre
description: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

name: Ducklett
description: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Haunter
description: It strikes at humans from total darkness. Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker with each passing day until they die.

name: Shinx
description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Camerupt
description: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

name: Rolycoly
description: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Delibird
description: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has a habit of sharing food with people lost in the mountains.

name: Kirlia
description: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer's feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.

name: Gyarados
description: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

name: Kleavor
description: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Alolan Sandshrew
description: It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is very hard—so much so, it can't roll its body up into a ball.

name: Blitzle
description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Trubbish
description: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

name: Rapidash
description: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd's pace and direction of travel.

name: Unown [E]
description: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

name: Minior
description: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.

name: Monferno

description: When this Pokémon sights its prey, it swirls its ribbonlike feelers as a distraction. A moment later, it pounces.

name: Omastar
description: Apparently, it cracked Shellder's shell with its sharp fangs and sucked out the insides.

name: Dugtrio

name: Simisear

name: Gigalith
description: Known for its hefty horsepower, this Pokémon is a popular partner for construction workers.

name: Alakazam
description: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

name: Horsea
description: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

description: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Litleo
description: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

description: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

name: Bronzong

description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

description: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

description: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even if someone just woke up.

description: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy TURTWIG, the shell should feel moist.

description: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.

description: There's a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong ______.

description: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

description: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

description: It forms a group of Rattata, which it assumes command of. Each group has its own territory, and disputes over food happen often.

description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

description: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hand and feet. It will take on any opponent.

description: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

description: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

description: ______'s breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

description: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

description: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

name: Eevee
description: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

description: With its psychic powers, it rewrites its opponents' memories. You, too, may have already had your memories rewritten.

description: ______'s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

description: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

description: Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

description: This vicious Pokémon sprays a poisonous liquid on opponents that come near. For whatever reason, it gets along really well with Dhelmise.

description: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

name: Eelektross
description: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.

name: Dedenne
description: It sneaks into people's homes and steals electricity from their outlets. When your electric bill seems off, it's the handiwork of this rascal.

name: Kirlia
description: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Whirlipede
description: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

name: Machop
description: It's said that not even pro wrestlers can take down a ______.

name: Victreebel
description: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.

name: Starly
description: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Drilbur
description: It's a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

name: Vullaby
description: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

name: Beldum
description: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

name: Aron
description: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

name: Herdier
description: The longer its black fur grows, the harder and more impervious it gets. Claws and fangs can't easily penetrate it.

name: Glameow
description: When it's happy, ______ demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

name: Spinarak
description: Some fishermen weave its sturdy thread into nets to catch fish Pokémon.

name: Gulpin
description: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.

name: Vibrava
description: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

name: Dark Hypno
description: Carries a pendulum with it always. Sometimes appears near less-traveled roads and schools at dusk.

name: Feraligatr
description: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

name: Gabite
description: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

name: Electivire
description: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

name: Cofagrigus
description: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

name: Klefki
description: It inserts its horn into chinks in metal, absorbing metal ions. For some reason, it collects keys.

name: Mesprit
description: When ______ flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.

name: Staryu
description: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but ______ isn't bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

name: Shining Kabutops
description: This ancient Pokémon uses its razor-sharp claws to cut open its prey and gain access to its blood.

name: Bewear
description: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

name: Tyrogue
description: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.

name: Klang
description: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

name: Phione
description: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

name: Sizzlipede
description: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

name: Swinub
description: It searches for food by digging into the ground with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn't give it any trouble.

name: Mawile
description: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

name: Vanilluxe
description: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

name: Simisear
description: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

name: Flittle
description: ______'s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

name: Spectrier
description: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. ______’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.

name: Lickitung
description: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

name: Metapod
description: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

name: Spinarak
description: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Exeggutor
description: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

name: Electrike
description: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Combusken
description: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

name: Umbreon
description: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it's filled with a mysterious power.

name: Marill
description: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

name: Growlithe
description: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Ponyta
description: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

name: Lombre
description: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.

name: Scraggy
description: It protects itself with its durable skin. It's thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

name: Metang
description: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

name: Thwackey
description: The faster a ______ can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

name: Drowzee
description: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children’s are much tastier.

name: Rookidee
description: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a ______'s eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.

name: Klink
description: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

name: Araquanid
description: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

name: Zygarde
description: It's hypothesized that it's monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.

name: Nuzleaf
description: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

name: Drapion
description: It takes great pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

name: Marill
description: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it's fine even in rivers with strong currents.

name: Dustox
description: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

name: Fidough
description: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in ______'s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

name: Makuhita
description: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

name: Galarian Mr. Rime
description: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

name: Nosepass
description: It moves less than an inch a year, but when it's in a jam, it will spin and drill down into the ground in a split second.

name: Fletchling
description: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

name: Growlithe
description: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

name: Jynx
description: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of ______ living in Alola are truly wonderful.

name: Burmy Sandy Cloak
description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

name: Bellsprout
description: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Tropius
description: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It’s a highly favored tropical snack.

name: Blissey
description: Even the most ferocious Pokémon become calm when they eat ______'s egg, which is said to be filled with happiness.

name: Dusknoir
description: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Pidgeot
description: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

name: Maschiff
description: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see ______'s face.

name: Lapras
description: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

name: Lucario
description: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to ______, since it can detect auras, even foes it could not otherwise see.

name: Magikarp
description: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

name: Gurdurr
description: ______ excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there's skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

name: Dark Blastoise
description: An aggressive Pokémon that tackles anything it sees.

name: Persian
description: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Oddish
description: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Latios
description: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Muk
description: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

name: Pansage
description: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

name: Aipom
description: It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, ______ gets excited and pounces.

name: Spewpa
description: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

name: Light Machamp
description: It uses its four arms in combat to unleash a ceaseless flurry of punches.

name: Skorupi
description: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

name: Corvisquire
description: It's said that the reason behind ______'s high level of intelligence is the large size of its brain relative to those of other bird Pokémon.

name: Charcadet
description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, ______ will battle even tough opponents.

name: Tinkatuff
description: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

name: Gyarados
description: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

name: Meowstic
description: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

name: Weedle
description: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

name: Cottonee
description: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

name: Medicham
description: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

name: Sewaddle
description: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

name: Hatenna
description: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

name: Luxray
description: ______ can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.

name: Dark Haunter
description: It silently hunts its prey in dark rooms.

name: Krookodile
description: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.

name: Timburr
description: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

name: Jellicent
description: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of ______ gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

name: Pidgeot
description: It spreads its beautiful wings wide to frighten its enemies. It can fly at Mach 2 speed.

name: Ting-Lu
description: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

name: Persian
description: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

name: Simipour
description: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Bisharp
description: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.

name: Pawniard
description: ______ will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

name: Carvanha
description: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

name: Pikachu
description: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Hypno
description: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves such as ______sis and Confusion.

name: Piplup
description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Alolan Sandshrew
description: An ancient tradition of Alolan festivals, still carried on to this day, is a competition to slide Sandshrew across ice as far as one can.

name: Dhelmise
description: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

name: Dugtrio
description: While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.

name: Clefable
description: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Unown [K]
description: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

name: Tangela
description: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

name: Mesprit
description: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.

name: Entei
description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Zygarde
description: This is ______'s form when about 10% of its cells have been gathered. It runs across the land at speeds greater than 60 mph.

name: Lapras
description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Luxio
description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Purugly
description: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.

name: Bewear
description: It waves its hands wildly in intimidation and warning. Life is over for anyone who doesn't run away as fast as possible.

name: Kricketot
description: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

name: Stunky
description: From its rear, it sprays a foul-smelling liquid at opponents. It aims for their faces, and it can hit them from over 16 feet away.

name: Galarian Perrserker
description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Magnezone
description: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

name: Numel
description: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

name: Mantine
description: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.

name: Sandile
description: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

name: Gyarados
description: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

name: Geodude
description: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

name: Dark Blastoise
description: An aggressive Pokémon that tackles anything it sees.

name: Ducklett
description: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Porygon
description: A man-made Pokémon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely in cyberspace.

name: Clauncher
description: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can shatter rock.

name: Wimpod
description: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

name: Alakazam
description: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

name: Delcatty
description: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Finneon
description: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They're popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.

name: Wormadam
description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Larvesta
description: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

name: Taillow
description: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

name: Shellder
description: The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.

name: Aron
description: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

name: Cresselia
description: Those who sleep holding ______'s feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Herdier
description: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed make this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

name: Arcanine
description: A Pokémon that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

name: Dark Porygon2
description: Advances in technology have allowed it to evolve. It occasionally displays behavior not found in its programming.

name: Swablu
description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Sewaddle
description: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

name: Grotle
description: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

name: Chikorita
description: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.

name: Chinchou
description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Lunala
description: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

name: Alolan Grimer
description: The crystals on Grimer's body are lumps of toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

name: Rotom
description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Lumineon
description: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

name: Team Rocket's Diglett
description: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

name: Seel
description: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

name: Toucannon
description: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

name: Joltik
description: ______ can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It's soaking up static electricity because it can't produce a charge on its own.

name: Clobbopus
description: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

name: Heracross
description: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It's strong enough to hurl foes.

name: Skitty
description: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Exploud
description: This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it'll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.

name: Sneasel
description: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

name: Munkidori
description: ______ keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

name: Bagon
description: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

name: Dodrio
description: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads—even for a second—will get pecked severely.

name: Primeape
description: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

name: Medicham
description: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

name: Gourgeist
description: In the darkness of a new-moon night, ______ will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

name: Larvesta
description: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed ______ had a nest on the sun.

name: Poochyena
description: ______ pursue their prey in packs. Once the prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.

name: Carvanha
description: Each school has its own territory. Any intruders are mercilessly attacked with fangs bared.

name: Skuntank
description: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

name: Stufful
description: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

name: Cradily
description: Normally, it lived on shallow sea shoals. When the tide went out, this Pokémon came up on land to search for prey.

name: Galvantula
description: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

name: Piplup
description: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Electabuzz
description: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.

name: Rolycoly
description: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Ditto
description: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

name: Arcanine
description: A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings.

name: Golurk
description: There's a theory that inside ______ is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn't been proven.

name: Solrock
description: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Wormadam Plant Cloak
description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Gogoat
description: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

name: Tapu Koko
description: Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Clawitzer
description: Its right arm is packed with meat. When its pincer falls off, it's exported to be used as a cooking ingredient.

name: Litleo
description: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

name: Pumpkaboo
description: It was recently discovered that the different varieties of ______ vary not only in size but also in the size of the souls they collect.

name: Krabby
description: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

name: Alolan Dugtrio
description: These Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

name: Rattata
description: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

name: Pikachu
description: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of ______ live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

name: Lickilicky
description: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

name: Shiftry
description: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

name: Eelektrik
description: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: Floatzel
description: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Octillery
description: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

name: Luxio
description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Reshiram
description: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

name: Sawsbuck
description: ______ in their Autumn Form are known for having very short tempers. The males fight each other incessantly.

name: Snubbull
description: In truth, it is a cowardly Pokémon. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

name: Hippopotas
description: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

name: Snorlax
description: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

name: Poliwrath
description: Its percentage of body fat is nearly zero. Its body is entirely muscle, which makes it heavy and forces its swimming prowess to develop.

name: Magneton
description: The Magnemite are united by a magnetism so powerful, it dries all moisture in its vicinity.

name: Morpeko
description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

name: Slowking
description: A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.

name: Scorbunny
description: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, ______’s footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

name: Burmy Plant Cloak
description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

name: Whismur
description: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs.  If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

name: Manectric
description: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

name: Meloetta
description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Goodra
description: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

name: Squirtle
description: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Magnemite
description: These Pokémon are attracted to electrical emissions and will often follow people using PokéGear.

name: Nuzleaf
description: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of ______'s grass flute fills listeners with dread.

name: Cinccino
description: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

name: Starly
description: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

name: Vileplume
description: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Unown
description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or ______ came first.

name: Nidoking
description: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

name: Spritzee
description: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a ______ that would waft a fragrance they liked.

name: Litwick
description: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

name: Mightyena
description: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Squirtle
description: Cute Pokémon that charms people with its innocent eyes. Loves swimming all day long.

name: Swanna
