name: Tentacruel
description: This Pokémon attacks its prey with its eighty toxin-producing tentacles.

name: Araquanid
description: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokémon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.

name: Honchkrow
description: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

name: Girafarig
description: Though very small, the brain in its tail is still considered an important organ because it emits powerful psychic energy.

name: Persian
description: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan ______, it's mostly made of the same material.

name: Bunnelby
description: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

name: Spinda
description: Each ______'s spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents' attacks brilliantly!

name: Alolan Vulpix
description: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

name: Hypno
description: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as ______sis and Confusion.

name: Psyduck
description: When headaches stimulate its brain cells, which are usually inactive, it can use a mysterious power.

name: Drilbur
description: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Froslass
description: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

name: Wurmple
description: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

name: Wishiwashi
description: ______ assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name "demon of the sea."

name: Tangela
description: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.

name: Binacle
description: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

name: Ursaring
description: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen berries.

name: Bellsprout
description: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

name: Azumarill
description: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

name: Swanna
description: It's said that many artists have taken inspiration from the sight of a ______ performing a beautiful dance in the light of dawn.

name: Helioptile
description: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

name: Pyroar
description: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.

name: Whiscash
description: It is very territorial. It repels foes by setting of tremors that extend over a three-mile radius.

name: Hoppip
description: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.

name: Alolan Meowth
description: When its delicate pride is wounded, or when the gold coin on its forehead is dirtied, it flies into a hysterical rage.

name: Toxicroak
description: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

name: Makuhita
description: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

name: Hawlucha
description: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

name: Volcarona
description: Thought to be an embodiment of the sun, it appeared during a bitterly cold winter and saved Pokémon from freezing.

name: Baltoy
description: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Rotom
description: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

name: Venonat
description: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

name: Lickilicky
description: It has space in its throat to store saliva. It can also roll up its tongue and store it in the same spot.

name: Illumise
description: With its sweet aroma, it guides VOLBEAT to draw signs with light in the night sky.

name: Magnemite
description: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges Thunder Wave and so on from the units at its sides.

name: Cherubi
description: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

name: Pinsir
description: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing its victim around and toss it hard.

name: Spearow
description: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

name: Butterfree
description: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

name: Zebstrika
description: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Team Rocket's Exeggutor
description: It is said that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

name: Beldum
description: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Fraxure
description: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

name: Gloom
description: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

name: Floatzel
description: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Venusaur
description: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Paras
description: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

name: Mabosstiff
description: ______ loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

name: Nuzleaf
description: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

name: Stunfisk
description: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

name: Vanilluxe
description: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

name: Mantine
description: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

name: Goomy
description: Their horns are powerful sensors. As soon as ______ pick up any sign of enemies, they go into hiding. This is how they've survived.

name: Crabominable
description: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

name: Chimchar
description: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

name: Tepig
description: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

name: Granbull
description: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it desperately flails its limbs about in an attempt to repel its opponent.

name: Steelix
description: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

name: Luxray
description: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey–even those taking shelter behind a wall.

name: Hisuian Overqwil
description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Golurk
description: It flies around the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

name: Arcanine
description: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can't help but grovel before it.

name: Alolan Graveler
description: When two Graveler fight each other, it fills the surroundings with flashes of light and sound. People call it the "fireworks of the earth."

name: Koffing
description: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.

name: Pumpkaboo
description: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

name: Archen
description: It was revived from an ancient fossil. Not able to fly, it lived in treetops and hopped from one branch to another.

name: Ninjask
description: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

name: Pawmi
description: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. ______ fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Latias
description: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisble.

name: Poochyena
description: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: Taillow
description: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

name: Mienshao
description: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
description: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

name: Volbeat
description: It flashes the light on its rear to communicate with other ______. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

name: Bunnelby
description: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.

name: Lucario
description: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

name: Lampent
description: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

name: Poochyena
description: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

name: Kilowattrel
description: ______ inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: Pumpkaboo
description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

name: Hoppip
description: It drifts on winds. It is said that when ______ gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

name: Magnezone
description: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by ______ is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.

name: Spidops
description: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

name: Skrelp
description: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.

name: Floette
description: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

name: Forretress
description: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters piece of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

name: Dark Dragonite
description: Sometimes called "The God of Destruction." Its wings are able to support it in spite of its massive weight.

name: Weepinbell
description: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

name: Lotad
description: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

name: Palkia
description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

name: Roselia
description: The more healthy the ______, the more pleasant its flowers' aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.

name: Hypno
description: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

name: Hisuian Arcanine
description: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

name: Jynx
description: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of ______ living in Alola are truly wonderful.

name: Xatu
description: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

name: Meltan
description: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Samurott
description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: Shelmet
description: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

name: Pangoro
description: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.

name: Shroomish
description: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

name: Charcadet
description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, ______ will battle even tough opponents.

name: Diglett
description: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

name: Whiscash
description: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, ______ will eat it.

name: Shelmet
description: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

name: Pineco
description: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

name: Solrock
description: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.

name: Oddish
description: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Dragonair
description: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

name: Bunnelby
description: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

name: Conkeldurr
description: It is thought that ______ taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

name: Yanmega
description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

name: Magmar
description: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Pidgeotto
description: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Sneasel
description: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

name: Bronzor
description: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

name: Seviper
description: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It's Zangoose's archrival.

name: Growlithe
description: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Fearow
description: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

name: Nickit
description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Cherubi
description: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

name: Paldean Wooper
description: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

name: Torkoal
description: Coal is the source of ______'s energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.

name: Girafarig
description: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

name: Wooper
description: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

name: Inkay
description: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

name: Corsola
description: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

name: Snorunt
description: It is said that several ______ gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

name: Pikachu
description: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.

name: Reshiram
description: When ______'s tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

name: Scrafty
description: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

name: Dodrio
description: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

name: Teddiursa
description: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

name: Dratini
description: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

name: Maractus
description: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

name: Volcanion
description: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

name: Galarian Yamask
description: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

name: Golbat
description: It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.

name: Ariados
description: It wanders in search of food after darkness falls, never nesting in a specific place.

name: Drampa
description: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it will completely destroy its surroundings with its intense breath.

name: Charmander
description: Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Qwilfish
description: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

name: Riolu
description: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

name: Charmander
description: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

name: Bramblin
description: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: Pancham
description: Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously, ______'s always giving others a glare. But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.

name: Watchog
description: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Articuno
description: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

name: Yamper
description: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

name: Banette
description: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

name: Chinchou
description: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Wobbuffet
description: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

name: Breloom
description: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

name: Mewtwo
description: A Pokémon whose genetic code was repeatedly recombined for research. It turned vicious as a result.

name: Excadrill
description: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

name: Voltorb
description: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to Screech or suddenly Self-Destruct.

name: Donphan
description: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

name: Gardevoir
description: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

name: Indeedee
description: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

name: Phantump
description: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit's rebirth as this Pokémon.

name: Froslass
description: It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome.

name: Honchkrow
description: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called "Summoner of Night."

name: Probopass
description: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

name: Jolteon
description: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Psyduck
description: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

name: Chimchar
description: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.

name: Hippowdon
description: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so ______ look after these Pokémon.

name: Pupitar
description: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

name: Slowpoke
description: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

name: Poltchageist
description: ______ looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

name: Dark Kadabra
description: Some people say that Kadabras are responsible for many of the mysterious events reported in the news.

name: Aegislash
description: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Braixen
description: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Hariyama
description: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

name: Patrat
description: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Poliwrath
description: With extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

name: Persian
description: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan ______, it's mostly made of the same material.

name: Pachirisu
description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Breloom
description: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.

name: Slowking
description: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

name: Froakie
description: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Litten
description: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, ______ sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.

name: Wailord
description: They eat so many fish Pokémon that when ______ become too numerous, fishermen have to chase them off.

name: Swinub
description: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.

name: Simisear
description: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

name: Skitty
description: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Tentacool
description: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.

name: Sharpedo
description: It has a sad history. In the past, its dorsal fin was a treasured foodstuff, so this Pokémon became a victim of overfishing.

name: Shinx
description: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it's in trouble.

name: Lombre
description: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

name: Cryogonal
description: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

name: Feraligatr
description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

name: Lapras
description: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

name: Magmar
description: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

name: Diglett
description: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

name: Loudred
description: It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then using its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.

name: Masquerain
description: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

name: Plusle
description: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Mismagius
description: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

name: Squirtle
description: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Charmander
description: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Quaxwell
description: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

name: Team Magma's Zangoose
description: Can you handle the formation attack of the fearless Zangoose?

name: Bronzor
description: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

name: Zapdos
description: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

name: Porygon
description: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

name: Combee
description: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

name: Metagross
description: With four linked brains, it's more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.

name: Dragonair
description: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

name: Lokix
description: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

name: Zoroark
description: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

name: Gothorita
description: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Girafarig
description: ______'s tail has a small head. It instinctively bites at any foe that approaches the Pokémon from behind.

name: Watchog
description: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Regigigas
description: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

name: Swoobat
description: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

name: Clefable
description: A timid Fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Alolan Marowak
description: The rich greenery of the Alola region is hard on Marowak. It controls fire to stay alive.

name: Sneasel
description: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

name: Staryu
description: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

name: Beartic
description: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways around the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.

name: Charmeleon
description: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Zubat
description: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, ______ flies around with skill.

name: Politoed
description: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

name: Meowth
description: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Wiglett
description: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Rapidash
description: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

name: Piplup
description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Luxio
description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Koffing
description: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

name: Poliwrath
description: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.

name: Diggersby
description: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

name: Treecko
description: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

name: Togedemaru
description: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Haunter
description: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.

name: Caterpie
description: Its feet have suction cups designed to stick to any surface. It tenaciously climbs trees to forage.

description: It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.

name: Cottonee
description: Weaving together the cotton of both ______ and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that's highly prized by many luxury brands.

name: Sandygast
description: It likes the shovel on its head, so ______ will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.

name: Munchlax
description: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.

name: Shining Gyarados
description: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Cosmog
description: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

name: Deoxys
description: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Audino
description: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

name: Pinsir
description: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing its victim around and toss it hard.

name: Snivy
description: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Garbodor
description: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

name: Lunatone
description: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Flamigo
description: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

name: Feebas
description: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

name: Togedemaru
description: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.

name: Grimmsnarl
description: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

name: Kakuna
description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

name: Geodude
description: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

name: Seviper
description: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

name: Dark Typhlosion
description: When it's in combat, the air around it shimmers and warps from the intense heat it produces.

name: Solosis
description: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.

name: Chimecho
description: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

name: Minun
description: Exposure to electricity from ______ and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

name: Decidueye
description: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

name: Toxicroak
description: The toxin made in its poison sacs is pumped to the knuckle claws through tubes down its arms.

name: Pawniard
description: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

name: Hariyama
description: ______ that are big and fat aren't necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.
